complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subset combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filtering valid triplets greedily verifies reachability in a single linear pass with constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate filters out triplets where any component exceeds the target, then checks if all three target values are matched.

hints.title: Exclusion of Invalid Triplets
hints.text: Any triplet containing an element strictly larger than its corresponding target element can never be included in merging operations.

hints.title: Component Matching Conditions
hints.text: Among triplets whose elements are all less than or equal to the target, record which components match the target values exactly.

hints.title: Simultaneous Match Check
hints.text: If there exists an eligible triplet matching the first coordinate, one matching the second, and one matching the third, the answer is true.
